narration.text: Why the Atlantic may vanish in 250 million years.
The continents could fuse into Pangaea Proxima.
In about 125 million years, the Atlantic stops widening.
Its seafloor would then start sinking back into Earth.
Another study favours a merger across the Pacific, within 200 to 300 million years.
Either way, it could split again after 400 to 500 million years.
Its interior would sit thousands of kilometres from any ocean.
So the map you know is one frame in a slow cycle.
